name: rsi_connors_pullback_v41
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms working large directional orders create persistent intraday trends over 20-45 minute windows. Within these trends, reactive retail stops and short-term momentum algos trigger brief 10-30 second counter-trend micro-pullbacks visible as extremely low RSI(6) readings (30-second RSI). The institutional order that created the trend has not been fully filled — when the micro-counter-move exhausts at RSI < 25, the underlying TWAP buy side resumes and NIFTY snaps back in the trend direction within 15-60 seconds. The edge is that RSI(6) detects the last sellers/buyers capitulating before the institutional engine resumes.
core_signal_oneliner: 30-second RSI drops below 25 within a 30-min SMA uptrend, detecting micro-pullback exhaustion before TWAP engine resumes
